spawn_rules: Enemies do not spawn arbitrarily on the map. They spawn from map objects or map areas that expose matching spawn tags.
An enemy may define up to three allowed SPAWN_TAG values.
The spawner may only select a spawn anchor whose tag matches one of the enemy's allowed SPAWN_TAG values.
Examples: Skeletons and zombies may use GRAVE, COFFIN or CRYPT anchors; human enemies may use HOUSE, TAVERN, FARM or WORKSHOP anchors.
Map generation must therefore attach spawn tags to relevant placed assets or areas.
Spawn tags define thematic origin, not combat behavior.
Wave availability is controlled separately through MIN_WAVE and MAX_WAVE.
SPAWN_RULE is reserved for additional restrictions such as INSIDE_ONLY, OUTSIDE_ONLY or NIGHT_ONLY if later required.
